hooks.command: filepath="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if echo "$filepath" | grep -qE '\.blade\.php$'; then php -l "$filepath" 2>&1 | tail -3; fi

cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-/Users/calmoulrich/ProjetsWeb/neogtb}" && echo '=== Scan pré-commit NeoGTB ===' && (grep -rn 'console.log' --include='*.blade.php' --include='*.js' admin/resources/ 2>/dev/null && echo 'WARN: console.log trouvé') || echo 'OK: Pas de console.log' && (grep -rn 'TODO' --include='*.blade.php' --include='*.php' admin/app/ admin/resources/ 2>/dev/null && echo 'WARN: TODO trouvé') || echo 'OK: Pas de TODO'

cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-/Users/calmoulrich/ProjetsWeb/neogtb}" && BLADES=$(git diff --name-only HEAD~1 -- '*.blade.php' 2>/dev/null | head -5); if [ -z "$BLADES" ]; then echo 'OK — aucun .blade.php modifié dans le dernier commit'; else echo "Blade modifiés: $BLADES"; for f in $BLADES; do [ -f "$f" ] && php -l "$f" 2>&1 | grep -v 'No syntax errors'; done; echo 'Revue terminée'; fi
